item.tib: dbang rdzogs sku lnga'i rtsa rgyud las lha gsas drug cu'i dbang byang smin grol rang rig rjen 'char bla med yang rtse
item.coloph: zhes bya ba 'di ni rtse dbus chos rje rin po che dang*/ skyi tshang bon mang gis snga mo nas dbang chen 'bum pa'i tshogs 'khor bcas bskul ba dang / lhag tu skyi bon gnam lha byams kyis 'bum pa'i dpe cha'i rten mtshan bcas nan cher mdzad/ nye bar rang slob snying gi thig le dmar po gyur pa dpal 'bum rgyal gtsos gling brgya'i bon mang gis yang yang bskur (bskul) ngor/ phran lung rtogs kyis dbul pa'i (ba'i) dus mtha'i sprang sdom dkon mchog 'jig med gling pas/ seng ge rgyab bsnol gyi sgom grwa theg chen 'phel rgyas gling nas bgyis tshe/ sde snod tha dag la rang byan chud pa'i mchog sprul g.yung drung bstan rgyas kyis kyang legs pa'i bya ba gnang zhing thugs dgyes dgyes mdzad pa dang bcas/ me 'brug lo'i hor zla gsum pa'i dkar phyogs su bgyis pa u ya dam tshig sa ma ya gu h+ya thim rgya//
